artifacts.title: Button
artifacts.summary: Action trigger. Use a real button or link; variants (primary/ghost/danger/small), busy state via guardApply. Never a clickable div.

a11y: Use a real <button> or <a>; never a clickable div.
Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
guardApply freezes and relabels the submit button until navigation.

artifacts.title: Icon button
artifacts.summary: Square icon-only control for compact toolbars and rows; must carry an aria-label.

a11y: aria-label is mandatory (the glyph is aria-hidden).
Minimum 44px on coarse pointers.

artifacts.title: Switch
artifacts.summary: The one boolean control for enabling/disabling an entity; auto-submits and announces.

a11y: The visible label wraps a real checkbox; hidden twin carries the off value.
aria-label carries the verb: Enable/Disable <object>.
Coarse pointers get a 44px hit area.
Disabled state dims the track and blocks interaction.

artifacts.title: Menu item
artifacts.summary: Item inside a dropdown menu; sentence case; destructive items carry 'menu-item danger arm-del'.

a11y: Destructive items use .arm-del with data-arm-label naming the object.
Escape and outside click disarm; details close disarms.

artifacts.title: Nav item
artifacts.summary: Sidebar/navigation link with icon, active rail state and aria-current.

a11y: aria-current="page" on the active item.
Active rail is border-inline-start (mirrors in RTL).

artifacts.title: Chip
artifacts.summary: Compact filter/selection token used in filter rows; distinct from badge (not a status).

a11y: Counts live in .n; the whole chip is the target (not just the label).

artifacts.title: Index row
artifacts.summary: Standard row for list/index pages: primary text, meta, optional actions.

a11y: 54px minimum height; one row = one destination.

artifacts.title: Table
artifacts.summary: Data table with sticky headers; collapses to card rows (.mcards) on phones.

a11y: th scope where the header is meaningful; row checkbox needs aria-label.
Hover-revealed row actions must also be reachable by keyboard focus.

artifacts.title: Bulk bar
artifacts.summary: Selection-only toolbar for batch operations; hidden until rows are selected.

a11y: role=region with aria-label; count is text, not colour.

artifacts.title: Save bar
artifacts.summary: Sticky footer for editors: primary Save plus Cancel; validation renders above, focused.

a11y: Lifts above the mobile keyboard via keyboard-fit.js (transform), not a class toggle.
One primary action per card.

artifacts.title: Flash message
artifacts.summary: Banner for server/redirect feedback; exactly ok/warn/err kinds.

a11y: role=status (or role=alert for errors) on the rendered banner.
Colour is always paired with text.

artifacts.title: Toast
artifacts.summary: Transient in-place feedback (one at a time) from the shared toast host.

a11y: #toasts is aria-live=polite; one toast at a time.

artifacts.title: Badge
artifacts.summary: Compact status label (uppercase micro-badge); pair colour with text, never colour alone.

a11y: Uppercase micro-label; never the only signal — pair with text that says the same thing.

artifacts.title: Empty state
artifacts.summary: Empty state anatomy: title, one-line reason, at most one primary CTA.

a11y: h4 + one-line reason + at most one action; never a bare blank area.

artifacts.title: Dialog (native)
artifacts.summary: Native dialog element for modals/confirms; static-backdrop variant available; dialog is the confirm primitive.

a11y: Native <dialog> + showModal(): top layer, inert background, Escape, focus restore — do not hand-roll a focus trap.
aria-labelledby points at the heading; autofocus the first meaningful control, not the close button.
Backdrop click closes unless the dialog is destructive.
Backdrop close is suppressed for [data-dlg-static] / [data-danger] dialogs.

artifacts.title: Tooltip
artifacts.summary: Tooltip for supplementary hints; hover/focus triggered.

a11y: Decorative tips only; essential text must be in the DOM. Pair with aria-describedby for screen readers.

artifacts.title: Spinner
artifacts.summary: Loading indicator for waiting states; pair with text describing what is loading.

a11y: Indeterminate progress: keep the action label honest ('Queued…'), and slow to 1s under prefers-reduced-motion.

artifacts.title: Field error
artifacts.summary: Inline field validation message; form-level summary focuses at top.

a11y: Focusable summary at the top + inline message per field, linked with aria-describedby; aria-invalid=true on the control (W3C ARIA21).

artifacts.title: Tabs
artifacts.summary: In-place view switcher; roving tabindex + arrow keys via components.js.

a11y: tablist/tab/tabpanel roles wired by components.js with roving tabindex and Arrow/Home/End.
Panels are hidden, not unmounted; one tab is always selected.

artifacts.title: Breadcrumbs
artifacts.summary: Breadcrumb trail for hierarchical navigation.

a11y: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] wraps an ordered list; plain text + separators.
aria-current on the leaf; the last item is not a link.

artifacts.title: Radio
artifacts.summary: Square single-choice control.

a11y: Native input inside the label; group with fieldset/radiogroup and a shared name.

artifacts.title: Slider
artifacts.summary: Range control with numeric readout.

a11y: aria-label on the range; the readout mirrors the value; keyboard steps come from the native input.

artifacts.title: Combobox
artifacts.summary: Combobox: type-to-filter select, optionally multi-select with chips and a mirror input.

a11y: aria-activedescendant listbox: focus stays in the input; options are filtered in place.
Multi-select mirrors values into a hidden input and announces chips via aria-live.

artifacts.title: Date picker
artifacts.summary: Date picker: text input plus calendar popover; min/max supported.

a11y: ISO value on the input; month/weekday names and full-date day labels via Intl (locale-aware).
Roving tabindex: exactly one day cell is tabbable — the selected day in view, else today, else the first enabled day.
Arrow keys move ±1/±7 days, Home/End to week start/end, PageUp/PageDown change month; disabled days are skipped.
Escape from anywhere inside the popup closes it and returns focus to the input; selecting a day does the same.
min/max disable days; today carries aria-current=date.
Clicking the input reopens the picker after a selection (the input is already focused, so no focus event fires).

artifacts.title: Accordion
artifacts.summary: Accordion/disclosure for collapsible sections.

a11y: Native details/summary — keyboard and find-in-page work for free; group with the details name attribute for exclusivity.

artifacts.title: Avatar
artifacts.summary: Square avatar chip for people. (avatar-sq)

a11y: Decorative avatars are aria-hidden; meaningful ones need alt/label. Groups carry an aria-label with the count.

artifacts.title: Image
artifacts.summary: Image presentation with system borders; always alt text.

a11y: alt is mandatory (TDS014); the frame reserves space so loading never shifts layout.

artifacts.title: Upload / dropzone
artifacts.summary: Dropzone + file input for uploads; dispatches triage:files.

a11y: role=button + Enter/Space; announces files with name and size; removal is a labelled button.

artifacts.title: Notifications
artifacts.summary: Notifications panel with unread dot and mark-all-read.

a11y: The summary's accessible name carries the unread count; unread uses background + a dot, never colour alone.

artifacts.title: Command palette
artifacts.summary: Command palette dialog (cmd-k style) with input, items and triggers.

a11y: Native dialog; Arrow/Enter/Escape inside, cmd/ctrl+K opens; items are buttons with listbox roles.
A click executes the clicked item (both data-href and data-cmd-action paths); Enter executes the highlighted item.

artifacts.title: Full-page state
artifacts.summary: Full-page state (e.g. fatal/empty app shell) with message and action.

a11y: One h2 per page state; the code is secondary; actions are the only focusable elements.

artifacts.title: Numbered pagination
artifacts.summary: Numbered pagination with page-size control; phone-trimmed.

a11y: aria-current marks the active page; range labels on prev/next; page-size select is labelled.

artifacts.title: Timeline
artifacts.summary: Timeline for histories (e.g. approval steps): ordered entries with markers, time, actor.

a11y: Ordered list; dots are decorative (the text carries the meaning).

artifacts.title: Diff
artifacts.summary: Diff presentation for before/after comparison.

a11y: role=table with labelled columns; +/- expressed as background tints plus repeated line numbers.

artifacts.title: Sheet dialog
artifacts.summary: End sheet: slide-over dialog variant for secondary panels.

a11y: Same native-dialog contract as .dlg (top layer, Escape, focus restore); data-dlg-static still blocks backdrop close.

artifacts.title: Select (native)
artifacts.summary: Native single-select for small fixed option sets; class .select for explicit citation (identical to the bare element); for the labelled assign flow (action + outcome) compose recipe/assign-picker; component/cb is the large/filtered-set option.

a11y: Native select: platform keyboard and screen-reader semantics; keep the visible <label for> association.
16px on phones (iOS anti-zoom) and the 44px minimum touch target come from the phone blocks in base.css.
Never replace a small fixed enumeration with a JS listbox; component/cb is for large or filtered sets.

artifacts.title: Progress bar
artifacts.summary: Determinate progress bar; compose with badge + text readout via recipe/job-progress; indeterminate waits use component/spinner.

a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin/max/now on the track; aria-valuetext carries the human readout (e.g. '12 of 40 scanned').
Always pair with an adjacent visible text readout — never colour alone.
Width transitions use --dur-progress; completion is announced via toast/banner.

artifacts.title: Dashboard / overview
artifacts.summary: Landing overview: hero metric strip, status/automation chips, recent-activity feed, follow-up cards.

artifacts.title: Detail / record page
artifacts.summary: Single-record page: page head with actions, fields, related lists, timeline.

artifacts.title: Settings
artifacts.summary: Task-sectioned settings cards with scoped partial saves.

artifacts.title: Flow / automation builder
artifacts.summary: Builder canvas for trigger → filter → action chains (node spine, insert-on-connector).

artifacts.title: Dry-run / simulator report
artifacts.summary: Two-column draft|report layout for previewing what an automated pipeline would do.

artifacts.title: Stepper / wizard
artifacts.summary: Multi-step task flow with step rail and per-step actions.

artifacts.title: Index & eval queue
artifacts.summary: Work-queue page: progress stats, per-item review rows, blind-labelling flow.

artifacts.title: Armed two-step delete
artifacts.summary: Deleting an entity listed in the UI is a two-step, in-place action with auto-disarm; no confirm() dialogs for these.

do: carry .arm-del with data-arm-label and a matching aria-label
arm on first activation (label becomes 'Confirm delete'), delete on second
auto-disarm after 4s, on Escape, outside click, or menu close
announce the result afterwards (banner or toast)
dont: no arming as a substitute for feedback

artifacts.title: High-stakes confirmations
artifacts.summary: Irreversible, security-relevant, or multi-item actions keep a native confirm() whose sentence names the object and consequence.

do: name the object and the consequence in the sentence
keep strings apostrophe-safe
reason-bearing reject/decline decisions pair the confirm with a required, labelled reason field recorded in history
dont: do not route entity deletes through confirm() (use arming)
body.quote: Representative set: remove account · reset tokens · rebuild the index · clear a chat · enable auto-apply · approve a risky plugin.

artifacts.title: Reversible mutations show the reverse
artifacts.summary: Edits undoable in place need no confirmation and no danger styling; put the reverse control next to the action.

do: pair remove ⇄ re-include, snooze ⇄ wake, tag ⇄ untag
dont: no confirms or danger styling for reversible edits
body.quote: Put the reverse control next to the action.

artifacts.title: Feedback routing: banner vs toast
artifacts.summary: Server/redirect results render an .msg banner; in-place JS results call toast(); kinds are exactly ok/warn/err.

do: announce every mutation unless the new state is self-evident in the same viewport
wording is past tense and names the object
dont: no page-local toast markup or query-param toasts
body.quote: There is no `info` kind — use `ok` for a benign outcome and `warn` when only part of it worked.

artifacts.title: Row actions
artifacts.summary: Clicking a row opens the record; secondary actions live in .rowacts, revealed on hover/focus (always visible on touch).

do: inline the relevant few with .ra-inline; rest in details.menu with .ra-menu
sentence case menu items; destructive item is 'menu-item danger arm-del'
dont: no grey tags/categories styling here — that's product convention
body.quote: Touch (≤767px): `.ra-inline` hides and the `⋯` menu shows.

artifacts.title: Editors end in a save bar
artifacts.summary: Editors end in .savebar: primary Save <thing> plus Cancel. Cancel is the way out; Back is only for a navigation backlink.

do: render server-side validation at the top of the form and focus it
settings cards keep scoped partial saves
dont: a card never submits fields it does not own
body.quote: Settings cards keep scoped partial saves.

artifacts.title: Empty state anatomy
artifacts.summary: .empty = optional icon, h4 title, one line of reason, at most one CTA (.btn primary).

do: use for any list or card with nothing to show
micro-empties inside a feed may be a single .sub line
dont: never a bare blank area or a bare 'failed'
body.quote: Give a specific reason and one recovery action.

artifacts.title: Copy helper owns the clipboard
artifacts.summary: Use the shared cp() helper / .copy element; the helper owns fallback and confirmation labelling.

do: .copy marks the copy affordance
dont: never call navigator.clipboard from page code
body.quote: The helper owns the fallback and the confirmation labelling.

artifacts.title: Labels & accessibility baseline
artifacts.summary: Sentence case for buttons/links/menu items; name the object; keep the global focus ring; 44px touch targets; colour never the only signal; every interactive element has an accessible name.

do: name the object in destructive labels and aria-labels
keep :focus-visible intact

artifacts.title: Colour is never the only signal
artifacts.summary: Status and meaning are carried by text or icon as well as colour; charts must survive greyscale and colour-blindness.

do: label status lines directly
vary dash patterns or annotate in charts
dont: no colour-only dots or fills for meaning
body.quote: Do not rely on colour alone: label lines directly, vary dash patterns, or annotate.

artifacts.title: Page hierarchy
artifacts.summary: One element, one token and one job per level: page title → section heading → card heading → body → meta. Don't skip levels.

do: let a long page title wrap at --fs-page-title
dont: don't shrink a page title with inline font-size
don't use a section heading as a card label
body.quote: Don't skip levels or spend a level you don't need.

artifacts.title: Overlay z-order
artifacts.summary: New full-screen overlays must clear the mobile tab bar; the ladder is tokenised (misc.zindex).

do: use ladder values from tokens

artifacts.title: Spacing by role, not by vibe
artifacts.summary: Use semantic spacing roles (page/card/field/control) and the preferred scale 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48; legacy steps remain only for compatibility.

do: snap new work to the preferred scale

artifacts.summary: Preferred scale 2/4/8/12/16/24/32/48 + semantic roles --space-page/card/field/control + legacy steps (compatibility).

artifacts.summary: Duration set (100–400ms) and easings; ad-hoc durations are off-token.

artifacts.summary: Radius policy 0, breakpoint set, z-index ladder, fixed layout widths (--layout-sidebar/content-max/dock).

artifacts.summary: Eight categorical series (Okabe-Ito derived), CVD-checked, for downstream chart code.
